fields.description: Issue includes editorials and commentary on high electric and power bills attributed to Florida Power & Light Company; discussion of safety concerns and fatalities involving Coral Gables rapid transit/streetcars along Coral Way; notes on civic matters including poll taxes and voting eligibility, city commission politics, and a Dade County grand jury recommendation regarding facilities for the care of the insane at the county stockade. Also covers local charitable fundraising and public sentiment distinguishing the Community Chest from the American Red Cross, along with assorted local columns, letters, legal notices, and extensive advertising and entertainment/sports promotions (including racing and nightlife).
